In alignment with the scope outlined in LGYINTAKE-40, this role will provide solutioning and development services to the VHB (Veterans Housing Benefit) environment. The AWS / ETL Engineer will support the VHB initiative to evaluate and build out an end-to-end communication workflow that generates and delivers high-volume outbound email through Salesforce, S-Docs, AWS, and VA Notify.
